_comment: Sample 3-node nodes.json for cluster g6e_12xl_x2__p4d_24xl_pp4_tp4. Copy to nodes.json and fill in private_ip when worker instances are up. node_rank field is required because two g6e nodes share the same instance_type — sync.sh / benchmark_single.sh in this cluster identify nodes by node_rank, not instance_type.

nodes.role: stages 2 + 3 — two TP=4 groups intra-node (8× A100 40GB, NVSwitch)
